findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_hotel_prices, get_tours, get_hanatour_ranking · Public sink: get_demand_index · Destructive: list_popular_packages.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_hotel_prices, get_tours, get_hanatour_ranking · Public sink: get_demand_index · Destructive: list_popular_packages

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
